title: Book Two · Chapter 136: A Summer Shelf
story:
In the middle of the holiday, Ronan clears his low shelf. He has outgrown two school books, but he does not put them in the rubbish.

Mum gives him three spaces on the floor.

“Keep. Give away. Ask first.”

Ronan puts the red sail book in the keep pile. The wooden boat stays beside it. He lifts a thin picture book, then pauses.

“Is this mine?”

“It came from Mr Qiu,” Mum says. “I do not remember if he lent it or gave it.”

Ronan puts it in the ask first pile.

He finds an old copy of the school guide behind a folder. The wrong day has a neat strip over it. For a moment he wants to tear it in half.

Instead he opens the picture. Mei's route still leads from the gate to the two doors. He puts the guide in the keep pile. His own place cards go above it.

There is more room on the shelf now. The old house picture stays above his bed. He wipes the frame with a dry cloth.

At the doorway, Mr Qiu is sorting his own books. Ronan takes the thin picture book to him.

“Did you lend me this?”

Mr Qiu looks at the front, then the first page.

“This was yours to keep. You paid a little for it.”

“Then I forgot.”

“That is allowed. You asked before you gave it away.”

Ronan returns to his room. He puts the book in the give away pile. He writes his name on a paper slip so Mum can check the pile.

Jun comes to the gate that afternoon. He needs a ruler for a home project. Ronan has one.

“Can I borrow it until Monday?” Jun asks.

“Yes.”

Ronan finds the ruler beneath his folder. Jun sees the three piles on the floor.

“Are those all going?”

“Only the middle pile.”

Jun points to a book about wheels.

“Can I look?”

Ronan gives it to him. Jun sits on the step and reads three pages. Then he puts it in the middle pile again.

“My brother might like that.”

“You can take it for him. Mum is checking them first.”

Mum checks the book and agrees. Jun takes it with the ruler.

At the gate, he says, “Monday.”

Ronan nods. “The ruler. The book can stay.”

“I know.”

After Jun leaves, Ronan returns the wooden boat to the shelf. There is space on both sides of it now. The room has not grown, but he can reach the things he wants.

He opens the red sail book on his knees. The first picture is very familiar. He reads the lines below it and goes on to the next page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

outgrow＝长大后不再适用；pile＝一堆；ruler＝尺子；familiar＝熟悉的。

## 理解问题

1. 为什么有一堆叫作Ask first？
2. Jun借走和获赠的物品分别是什么？

## 读句子

**Jun / sits on the step / and reads three pages.** Jun／坐在台阶上／读了三页。
